name: Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer weekdays at the hospital, usually one four hour shift a week, for at least 80 hours.
who_can_apply: Students who can commit at least 80 hours, Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm. Needs a 3.0 GPA or higher and two reference letters (not family). The page does not state an age.
duration: At least 80 hours; about one 4 hour shift a week
deadline_text: Apply online any time; then an interview and health screening.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Interview with Volunteer Services. Bring 2 reference letters. Pass the health screen. Call 904-244-4232.
notes: UF Health Jacksonville can say no to any applicant. Age limits for students were not stated. Confirm before you apply.
